dialog.english:
nd waited, but
nobody came.
dialog.translation: y esperé, pero nadie vino.

dialog.english:
When I evolved into Plotmon, I 
stopped waiting and went on a 
journey to find them myself...
dialog.translation:
Cuando evolucioné a Salamon, dejé
de esperar y salí a buscarla
por mi cuenta...

dialog.english:
But the one who appeared before me
wasn't the eighth Chosen Child,
but Vamdemon...
dialog.translation:
Pero quien apareció ante mí no
era el octavo Niño Elegido,
sino Myotismon...

dialog.english:
And then the days of despair
began, and at some point I forgot
that I was waiting for someone...
dialog.translation:
Así empezaron los días de
desesperación, hasta que
olvidé que esperaba a alguien.

dialog.english:
I-I don't understand. What's the
eighth Chosen Child?
dialog.translation:
N-no lo entiendo. Qué es eso
del octavo Niño Elegido?

dialog.english: Heeeeeey! Kari!
dialog.translation: Eeeeh! Kari!

dialog.english: Tai!
dialog.translation: Tai!

dialog.english: You're...
dialog.translation: Sois...

dialog.english: Wait! Hear us out!
dialog.translation: Espera, óyenos!

dialog.english:
Kari, get away from them! These
guys are our enemies!
dialog.translation:
Kari, apártate de ellos!
Son nuestros enemigos!

dialog.english:
Get away from her, both of you!
Llama Bebé!
dialog.translation:
Apártate de ella, los dos!
Llama Bebé!

dialog.english: Stop it...
dialog.translation: Parad...

dialog.english: Kari! Get out of the way!
dialog.translation: Kari! Apártate de ahí!

dialog.english: Tailmon!
dialog.translation: Gatomon!

dialog.english:
I'm fine, Kari. That's not
enough to hurt me.
dialog.translation:
Estoy bien, Kari. Eso no
me hace daño.

dialog.english:
Tailmon just threw herself in
front of Kari...
dialog.translation:
Gatomon se interpuso entre
Kari y el ataque...

dialog.english:
Have you recovered the memories
you locked away?
dialog.translation:
Recuperaste los recuerdos
que tenías bloqueados?

dialog.english:
Yes. I was waiting for the eighth
Chosen Child... I was waiting for
Kari.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Esperaba al octavo Niño
Elegido... Esperaba a Kari.

dialog.english: So Tailmon is my Digimon!
dialog.translation: Gatomon es mi Digimon!

dialog.english:
That's right. Kari is the eighth
Chosen Child.
dialog.translation:
Así es. Kari es el octavo
Niño Elegido.

dialog.english: And I'm her Digimon...
dialog.translation: Y yo soy su Digimon...

dialog.english:
Okay, Tailmon, so even if this is
true, who's that guy over there?
dialog.translation:
Vale, Gatomon, aunque sea
verdad, quién es ese tío
de ahí?

dialog.english: He's my friend.
dialog.translation: Es mi amigo.

dialog.english:
You can't just expect me to
believe that!
dialog.translation:
No pretendas que me crea
eso sin más!

dialog.english:
It doesn't matter if you believe
me or not, but at least take the
Digivice.
dialog.translation:
No importa si me crees o no,
pero al menos coge el
Digivice.

dialog.english:
Why are you giving her Digivice to
Tai?
dialog.translation:
Por qué le das su Digivice
a Tai?

dialog.english:
It would be dangerous if Vamdemon
found out about Kari and
Tailmon.
dialog.translation:
Sería peligroso que Myotismon
descubriera lo de Kari y
Gatomon.

dialog.english:
But if you have the Digivice, both
of them will be safe.
dialog.translation:
Pero si tú tienes el Digivice,
los dos estaréis a salvo.

dialog.english:
Okay, I'll take care of this. What
are you gonna do now?
dialog.translation:
Vale, yo me encargo. Y
vosotros qué haréis ahora?

dialog.english:
We need Kari's Crest. The real
one...
dialog.translation:
Necesitamos el Emblema
real de Kari...

dialog.english: Real?
dialog.translation: Real?

dialog.english:
The one we have is a fake.
Vamdemon has the real one.
dialog.translation:
El que tenemos es falso.
Myotismon tiene el auténtico.

dialog.english:
Wait here. We'll go and bring it
back.
dialog.translation:
Esperad aquí. Iremos a
recuperarlo.

dialog.english:
Wait! Where's Vamdemon's base?
We'll go with you.
dialog.translation:
Espera! Dónde está su base?
Vamos también.

dialog.english: You can't. It's too dangerous.
dialog.translation: No podéis. Es muy peligroso.

dialog.english: Tailmooooooon!
dialog.translation: Tailmooooooon!

dialog.english:
Kari's Crest should be hidden
around here.
dialog.translation:
El Emblema debe estar
escondido por aquí.

dialog.english:
This place is off-limits until
Lord Vamdemon returns!
dialog.translation:
Zona prohibida hasta que
vuelva el Amo Myotismon!

dialog.english:
We came to switch out the guard.
See?
dialog.translation:
Venimos a relevar la
guardia. Ves?

dialog.english: Huh? What was I doing here?
dialog.translation: Eh? Qué hacía yo aquí?

dialog.english:
Weren't you going to switch off
with us and go home?
dialog.translation:
No ibas a relevarnos e
irte a casa?

dialog.english: Ah, right...Okay, I'll be leaving.
dialog.translation: Ah, cierto...Vale, me marcho.

dialog.english: Good night.
dialog.translation: Hasta luego

dialog.english:
Where's the Crest? We have to
hurry up and find it.
dialog.translation:
Dónde está el Emblema? Hay
que encontrarlo ya.

dialog.english:
Don't rush things. Vamdemon won't
return until dawn.
dialog.translation:
No corras. Myotismon no
volverá hasta el amanecer.

dialog.english: Here it is!
dialog.translation: Aquí está!

dialog.english:
No doubt about it, it's the real
Crest.
dialog.translation:
No hay duda, es el Emblema
auténtico.

dialog.english:
So what are you going to do, now
that you've stolen the real Crest?
dialog.translation:
Y qué pensáis hacer, ahora
que habéis robado el
Emblema auténtico?

dialog.english: What!?
dialog.translation: Qué?!

dialog.english:
Have you allied yourselves with
the Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
Os habéis aliado con los
Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
Those eyes of yours...I always
knew they were like a dagger
pointed my way.
dialog.translation:
Esos ojos tuyos...siempre
supe que eran como una
daga apuntándome.

dialog.english: I'll take you down!
dialog.translation: Te derrotaré!

dialog.english:
I'll take care of you first,
Wizarmon.
dialog.translation:
Primero me encargaré de
ti, Wizardmon.

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaargh!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaaaargh!

dialog.english:
Vamdemon, I'm the one you should
be fighting!
dialog.translation:
Myotismon, soy yo contra
quien debes luchar!

dialog.english:
Those eyes! They're shining with
the light of hope, the light that
believes in dreams...
dialog.translation:
Esos ojos! Brillan con la
luz de la esperanza, la luz
que cree en los sueños...

dialog.english:
That's right! I've made it this
long because I believed in that!
dialog.translation:
Así es! He llegado hasta
aquí porque creía en eso!

dialog.english:
If I believe in it, I can have
hopes and dreams! And I'll defeat
you to make my dream come true!
dialog.translation:
Si creo en ello, puedo tener
esperanzas y sueños! Te derrotaré
y cumpliré mi sueño!

dialog.english: What?
dialog.translation: Qué?

dialog.english:
I can't take back my true self
unless I defeat you!
dialog.translation:
No recupero mi verdadero
yo si no te derroto!

dialog.english:
Take back your true self...could
you possibly be the eighth
Digimon?!
dialog.translation:
Recuperar tu verdadero
yo...serás acaso el
octavo Digimon?!

dialog.english:
I see! Now *that's* a completely
different story! First, I'll send
your precious friend to hell!
dialog.translation:
Vaya, otra historia distinta!
Antes, enviaré a tu preciado
amigo al infierno!

dialog.english: Tailmon!
dialog.translation: Gatomon!

dialog.english: Wizarmon!
dialog.translation: Wizardmon

dialog.english: Wizarmon!
dialog.translation: Wizardmon

dialog.english: Hahahaha!
dialog.translation: Jajajaja!

dialog.english: We came to help you, Tailmon!
dialog.translation:
Venimos a ayudarte,
Gatomon!

dialog.english: Tai!
dialog.translation: Tai!

dialog.english:
What a privilege it is, to see you
come to me so easily.
dialog.translation:
Qué privilegio veros venir
hasta mí tan fácilmente.

dialog.english: Gaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Gaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Greymon, evolve!
dialog.translation: Evoluciona!

dialog.english:
You think I'll be beaten by such
child's play?
dialog.translation:
Crees que un truco de
niños me va a derrotar?

dialog.english: Gh!
dialog.translation: Gh!

dialog.english:
The fact that a Chosen Child came
out here to help you means that 
you really are the eighth Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Que un Niño Elegido haya venido
a ayudarte demuestra que de
verdad eres el octavo Digimon.

dialog.english:
W-what are you talking about? I'm
not the eighth Digimon at all.
dialog.translation:
Q-qué dices? Yo no soy el
octavo Digimon en absoluto.

dialog.english:
We'll see about that. I'll use you
as bait to lure out the eighth
child.
dialog.translation:
Ya lo veremos. Te usaré de
cebo para atraer al octavo
niño.

dialog.english:
I may not have the Crest anymore,
but I'll find the eighth child
soon enough...
dialog.translation:
Puede que ya no tenga el
Emblema, pero encontraré
al octavo niño muy pronto...

dialog.english: That's cheap, Vamdemon!
dialog.translation: Qué ruin, Myotismon!

dialog.english: Farewell for now...
dialog.translation: Adiós por ahora...

dialog.english: Wait...
dialog.translation: Espera!

dialog.english: Muahahahahaha...
dialog.translation: Muajajajaja...

dialog.english:
Tailmon... You'll come back,
right? You'll come back...
dialog.translation:
Gatomon...volverás,
verdad? Volverás...

dialog.english: Tailmoooooooooooon!
dialog.translation: Tailmoooooooon!
